en.s: Napoleon was crowned Emperor of the French on December 2, 1804 (11 Frimaire, Year XIII according to the French Republican calendar, commonly used at the time in France), at Notre-Dame de Paris in Paris. en.s: The Battle of Austerlitz (2 December 1805/11 Frimaire An XIV FRC), also known as the Battle of the Three Emperors, was one of the most important and decisive engagements of the Napoleonic Wars. In what is widely regarded as the greatest victory achieved by Napoleon, the Grande Armée of France defeated a larger Russian and Austrian army led by Tsar Alexander I and Holy Roman Emperor Francis II. The battle occurred near the village of Austerlitz in the Austrian Empire (modern-day Slavkov u Brna in the Czech Republic).

en.s: The United States presidential election of 1812 was the seventh quadrennial presidential election. It was held from Friday, October 30 to Wednesday, December 2, 1812, and took place in the shadow of the War of 1812. It featured an intriguing competition between incumbent Democratic-Republican President James Madison and a dissident Democratic-Republican, DeWitt Clinton, nephew of Madison's late Vice President, George Clinton. The Federalist opposition threw their support behind Clinton. Nonetheless, Madison was re-elected with 50.4 percent of the popular vote, making the 1812 election the closest election up to that point for the popular vote.

en.s: The Battle of Ndondakusuka, often known as the Second Zulu Civil War, fought on 2 December 1856, was the culmination of a succession struggle in the Zulu Kingdom between Cetshwayo and Mbuyazi, the two eldest sons of King Mpande. zh.s: 恩东达库苏卡之战又称第二次祖鲁内战，发生于1856年12月2日，是祖鲁王国王位继承斗争的高潮。姆潘德国王的两个长子切茨瓦约和姆布亚齐争夺王位，姆布亚齐在战斗中败亡，切茨瓦约因此实际掌控王国，但其父仍在位为王。

en.t: Origins of the American Civil War: Militant abolitionist leader John Brown is hanged for his October raid on Harpers Ferry, Virginia (now West Virginia)
en.s: The origins of the American Civil War were rooted in the desire of the Southern states to preserve and expand the institution of slavery. Historians in the 21st century overwhelmingly agree on the centrality of slavery in the conflict, but they disagree on the North's reasons for refusing to allow the Southern states to secede.

zh.s: 美国内战的起因植根于南方各州维护并扩大奴隶制的意图。21世纪的历史学家普遍认为奴隶制是这场冲突的核心原因，但他们对北方拒绝允许南方各州脱离联邦的理由仍有不同看法。

en.s: The Battle of Walker's Ford (December 2, 1863) saw three Confederate cavalry brigades led by Brigadier General William T. Martin attack a Union cavalry brigade under Colonel Felix W. Graham at Walker's Ford on the Clinch River during the Knoxville campaign of the American Civil War. After failing to trap Graham's brigade at Maynardville, Tennessee, Martin's cavalry pursued in the direction of Tazewell before encountering Graham's horsemen south of Walker's Ford in the morning.

zh.s: 1863年12月2日，诺克斯维尔战役期间，威廉·T·马丁准将率领3个邦联骑兵旅，在田纳西州沃克福特附近的克林奇河畔进攻菲利克斯·W·格雷厄姆上校率领的联邦骑兵旅。此前，马丁的骑兵未能在梅纳德维尔包围格雷厄姆的部队，随后向塔兹韦尔方向追击，并于清晨在沃克福特以南遇上格雷厄姆的骑兵。

en.s: The Battle of Mine Run, also known as Payne's Farm, or New Hope Church, or the Mine Run campaign (November 27 – December 2, 1863), was conducted in Orange County, Virginia, in the American Civil War. An unsuccessful attempt of the Union Army of the Potomac to defeat the Confederate Army of Northern Virginia, it was marked by false starts and low casualties and ended hostilities in the eastern theater for the year.

en.s: The Burning Raid was a Union raid conducted in the Loudoun Valley of Loudoun and Fauquier counties in Virginia in 1864 during the American Civil War. It was aimed at destroying the forage on which Confederate partisans operating in the area, specifically Mosby's Rangers, subsisted as well as at breaking the will of the citizens of the area for supporting the partisans.

en.s: The 1869 Mississippi gubernatorial election was held from November 30 to December 2, 1869, in order to elect the Governor of Mississippi. James L. Alcorn, Republican and moderate planter who had previously served in the Confederate Army, defeated National Union Republican Party nominee Judge Lewis Dent, the brother-in-law of President Ulysses S. Grant and former Union Army official. The Democratic Party supported Dent rather than nominating their own candidate.

en.s: The Battle of Loigny–Poupry was a battle of the Franco–Prussian War. It took place on 2 December 1870 during the Loire Campaign near the town of Loigny. An army detachment (Armee-Abteilung) under the command of Friedrich Franz II, Grand Duke of Mecklenburg-Schwerin, engaged the French Army of the Loire and defeated them. The French force was led by General Gaston de Sonis, an experienced cavalry commander. His core troops (about 300) comprised a mixture of Saraphis and Zouaves. Their support troops (the 51st Foot, a largely untrained motley group of conscripts) fell back, leaving de Sonis to make a stand, which he and his Zouaves and Saraphis did.

zh.s: 卢瓦尼—普普里之战是普法战争卢瓦尔战役期间的一场战斗，于1870年12月2日在卢瓦尼镇附近发生。梅克伦堡-什未林大公弗里德里希·弗朗茨二世率领一支德军分队与卢瓦尔军团交战并将其击败。法军由经验丰富的骑兵指挥官加斯东·德·索尼斯将军率领。他的核心部队约300人，由萨拉菲兵和祖阿夫兵组成；一支以未经训练的新兵为主的第51步兵团撤退后，德·索尼斯与萨拉菲兵和祖阿夫兵继续坚守。

en.s: The Battle of Peiwar Kotal was fought on 2 December 1878 between British forces under Major General Frederick Roberts and Afghan forces under Karim Khan, during the opening stages of the Second Anglo-Afghan War. The British were victorious, and seized the strategic Peiwar Kotal Pass leading into the interior of Afghanistan.

zh.s: 1878年12月2日，第二次英阿战争初期，弗雷德里克·罗伯茨少将率领的英军与卡里姆汗率领的阿富汗军队在佩瓦尔科塔尔交战。英军获胜，并占领了通往阿富汗内陆的战略要地佩瓦尔科塔尔山口。

en.s: The 1879 Louisiana gubernatorial election was the first election to take place under the Louisiana Constitution of 1879. As a result of this election Louis A. Wiltz became Governor of Louisiana. The election saw widespread intimidation of African Americans which guaranteed the election of the Democratic nominee.

zh.s: 这是路易斯安那州1879年宪法通过后的首次选举。路易斯·A.威尔茨因此当选州长。选举期间，非裔美国人遭到大范围恐吓，这确保了民主党候选人获胜。

en.s: The 1880 New South Wales colonial election was held between 17 November and 2 December 1880. This election was for all of the 108 seats in the New South Wales Legislative Assembly and it was conducted in 43 single-member constituencies, 25 2-member constituencies, one 3-member constituency and three 4-member constituencies, all with a first past the post system.

zh.t: 1880年新南威尔士殖民地议会选举
zh.s: 1880年新南威尔士殖民地议会选举于11月17日至12月2日举行，改选立法议会全部108个席位。选区包括43个单席选区、25个双席选区、1个三席选区和3个四席选区，均采用相对多数制。

en.s: The 1881 Quebec general election was held on December 2, 1881, to elect members of the 5th Legislative Assembly for the province of Quebec, Canada. The Quebec Conservative Party, led by Premier Joseph-Adolphe Chapleau, defeated the Quebec Liberal Party, led by Henri-Gustave Joly de Lotbinière. The turnout was 44.53%.

zh.s: 1881年12月2日，加拿大魁北克省举行大选，选出该省第五届立法议会议员。由省长约瑟夫-阿道夫·沙普洛领导的魁北克保守党击败了由亨利-古斯塔夫·若利·德洛蒂比尼埃领导的魁北克自由党。投票率为44.53%。

en.s: The Battle of Tirad Pass (Filipino: Labanan Sa Pasong Tirad), sometimes referred to as the "Philippine Thermopylae", was a battle in the Philippine-American War fought on December 2, 1899, in northern Luzon in the Philippines, in which a 60-man Filipino rear guard commanded by Brigadier General Gregorio del Pilar succumbed to over 500 Americans, mostly of the 33rd Volunteer Infantry Regiment under Major Peyton C. March, while delaying the American advance to ensure that President Emilio Aguinaldo and his troops escaped.

zh.s: 提拉德山口之战有时被称为“菲律宾的温泉关之战”，是菲律宾—美国战争期间于1899年12月2日在菲律宾吕宋岛北部发生的一场战斗。格雷戈里奥·德尔·皮拉尔准将率领60名菲律宾后卫部队，抵挡了500多名美军，其中大多数来自佩顿·C·马奇少校指挥的第33志愿步兵团。后卫部队最终战败，但拖延了美军推进，使埃米利奥·阿吉纳尔多总统及其部队得以撤离。

en.t: Puyi becomes Emperor of China at the age of two
en.s: Puyi (Chinese: 溥儀; pinyin: Pǔ Yí; Wade–Giles: P'u-i; 7 February 1906 – 17 October 1967) was the last emperor of China, having reigned as the Xuantong Emperor of the Qing dynasty (1908–1912, with a brief restoration in 1917) and later as the Kangde Emperor of Manchukuo, a Japanese puppet state during World War II.

zh.t: 两岁的溥仪成为中国皇帝
zh.s: 溥仪（中文：溥儀；拼音：Pǔ Yí；威妥玛拼音：P'u-i；1906年2月7日—1967年10月17日）是中国最后一位皇帝。1908年至1912年间，他以清朝宣统皇帝的身份在位，1917年曾短暂复辟；后来又成为伪满洲国康德皇帝。伪满洲国是二战期间日本扶植的傀儡政权。

Ricardo Jiménez Oreamuno of the Republican Party won the presidential election, whilst the party also won the parliamentary election, in which they received 51.5% of the vote. en.s: Peking Man (Homo erectus pekinensis, originally "Sinanthropus pekinensis") is a subspecies of H. erectus which inhabited what is now northern China during the Middle Pleistocene. Its fossils have been found in a cave some 50 km (31 mi) southwest of Beijing (referred to in the West as Peking upon its first discovery), known as the Zhoukoudian Peking Man Site.

zh.t: 裴文中发现北京人头盖骨
zh.s: 北京人（Homo erectus pekinensis，最初称为“Sinanthropus pekinensis”）是直立人亚种，中更新世时生活在今中国北方。其化石发现于北京西南约50公里（31英里）处的一座洞穴中；该遗址如今称为周口店北京人遗址。北京最初发现此化石时，西方称其为“Peking”。

en.s: The 1931 Salvadoran coup d'état occurred on 2 December 1931 when the Armed Forces of El Salvador overthrew President Arturo Araujo. The Civic Directory (a military junta) ruled El Salvador for two days after the coup until it relinquished power to Brigadier General Maximiliano Hernández Martínez, Araujo's Vice President and Minister of War, the Navy, and Aviation.

en.s: LaGuardia Airport (IATA: LGA, ICAO: KLGA, FAA LID: LGA) is a civil airport in East Elmhurst, Queens, New York City, United States, situated on the northwestern shore of Long Island, bordering Flushing Bay. en.s: The Battle of Hanko (also known as the Hanko front or the siege of Hanko) was a lengthy series of small battles fought on Hanko Peninsula during the Continuation War between Finland and the Soviet Union in the second half of 1941. As both sides were eager to avoid a major, costly ground battle, fighting took the form of trench warfare, with artillery exchanges, sniping, patrol clashes, and small amphibious operations performed in the surrounding archipelago.

en.s: The Battle of Skerki Bank (La distruzione del Convoglio "Aventino") was an engagement during the Second World War which took place near Skerki Bank in the Mediterranean Sea in the early hours of 2 December 1942. Force Q, a flotilla of Royal Navy cruisers and destroyers, attacked Convoy H, an Italian convoy and its Regia Marina escort of destroyers and torpedo boats.

zh.s: 斯凯尔基浅滩之战又称“阿文蒂诺”船队覆灭，是第二次世界大战期间于1942年12月2日凌晨在地中海斯凯尔基浅滩附近发生的一场战斗。英国皇家海军的“Q”编队由巡洋舰和驱逐舰组成，袭击了意大利“H”船队及护航的意大利皇家海军驱逐舰和鱼雷艇。

en.s: The air raid on Bari was an air attack by German bombers on Allied forces and shipping in Bari, Italy, on 2 December 1943 during World War II. In the attack, 105 German Junkers Ju 88 bombers of Luftflotte 2, achieving complete surprise, bombed shipping and personnel operating in support of the Allied Italian campaign, sinking 27 cargo and transport ships and a schooner in Bari harbour. The attack, which lasted a little more than one hour, put the port out of action until February 1944 and was called the "Little Pearl Harbor".

zh.s: 1943年12月2日，第二次世界大战期间，德国轰炸机袭击了意大利巴里的盟军部队和船只。德国空军第2航空队出动105架容克Ju 88轰炸机，突袭巴里港内为盟军意大利战役提供支援的船只和人员，击沉27艘货船和运输船以及1艘纵帆船。空袭持续了一个多小时，导致港口停用至1944年2月。这次袭击后来被称为“小珍珠港”。

en.s: The 1944 Sydney City Council election was held on 2 December 1944 to elect 20 councillors to the City of Sydney. en.s: The Palmerston North by-election of 1967 was a by-election for the electorate of Palmerston North on 2 December 1967 during the 35th New Zealand Parliament. The by-election resulted from the death of the previous member Bill Brown of the National Party on 16 October 1967. Brown had held the seat since 1960, when he won it from Phil Skoglund of the Labour Party. The by-election was won by Joe Walding of the Labour Party, and he held the seat for the next two elections, 1969 and 1972.

en.s: The 1985 Quebec general election was held on December 2, 1985, to elect members of the National Assembly of the Province of Quebec, Canada. The Quebec Liberal Party, led by former premier Robert Bourassa, defeated the incumbent Parti Québécois, led by Premier Pierre-Marc Johnson. This election marked the comeback of Robert Bourassa, whose political career had been thought to be over after losing the 1976 general election and resigning as Liberal leader.

zh.s: 1985年12月2日，加拿大魁北克省举行大选，选出省议会议员。由前省长罗伯特·布拉萨领导的魁北克自由党击败了由省长皮埃尔-马克·约翰逊领导的魁北克人党。这次选举标志着布拉萨重返政坛；此前，他在1976年大选失利并辞去自由党领袖职务后，政治生涯一度被认为已经结束。

en.s: STS-27 was the 27th NASA Space Shuttle mission, and the third flight of Space Shuttle Atlantis. Launching on December 2, 1988, on a four-day mission, it was the second shuttle flight after the Space Shuttle Challenger disaster of January 1986. STS-27 carried a classified payload for the U.S. Department of Defense (DoD), ultimately determined to be a Lacrosse surveillance satellite.

zh.s: STS-27是美国国家航空航天局第27次航天飞机任务，也是“亚特兰蒂斯”号航天飞机的第三次飞行。任务于1988年12月2日发射，持续4天。这是1986年“挑战者”号航天飞机失事后第二次执行的航天飞机任务。机上搭载了一件美国国防部机密载荷，后来确认是“长曲棍球”侦察卫星。

en.t: Benazir Bhutto (pictured) took office as Prime Minister of Pakistan, becoming the first woman to head the government of a Muslim-majority state
en.s: Benazir Bhutto (21 June 1953 – 27 December 2007) was a Pakistani stateswoman who twice served as the Prime Minister of Pakistan from 1988 to 1990 and again from 1993 to 1996. She was the first woman elected to head a democratic government in a Muslim-majority country. Ideologically a liberal and a secularist, she chaired the Pakistan People's Party (PPP) from 1982 until her assassination in 2007.

zh.t: 贝娜齐尔·布托就任巴基斯坦总理，成为首位领导穆斯林多数国家政府的女性
zh.s: 贝娜齐尔·布托（1953年6月21日—2007年12月27日）是巴基斯坦政治家，曾两度担任巴基斯坦总理：第一次为1988年至1990年，第二次为1993年至1996年。她是首位当选为穆斯林多数国家民选政府首脑的女性。她在意识形态上持自由主义和世俗主义立场，并于1982年至2007年遇刺身亡前担任巴基斯坦人民党（PPP）主席。

en.s: The Hat Yai Peace Agreement marked the end of the Communist insurgency in Malaysia (1968–1989). It was signed and ratified by the Malayan Communist Party (MCP), and the Malaysian and Thailand governments at the Lee Gardens Hotel in Hat Yai, Thailand, on 2 December 1989.

en.s: German federal elections took place on 2 December 1990, to elect members to the 12th Bundestag (parliament) of the Federal Republic of Germany. It was the first free and universal election in all of Germany since the election of 1932 which cemented Adolf Hitler's power. The result was a comprehensive victory for the governing coalition of the Christian Democratic Union/Christian Social Union and the Free Democratic Party, which was reelected to a third term.

zh.s: 德国于1990年12月2日举行联邦选举，选出德意志联邦共和国第12届联邦议院议员。这是1932年选举巩固阿道夫·希特勒权力以来，德国首次举行覆盖全国且自由、普选的选举。基督教民主联盟／基督教社会联盟与自由民主党组成的执政联盟大获全胜，连任第三届政府。

en.s: The 1990 Berlin state election was held on 2 December 1990 to elect the members of the 12th Abgeordnetenhaus of Berlin. This was the first election held in Berlin after the reunification of Germany and Berlin, and was held on the same day as the 1990 federal election. The Christian Democratic Union (CDU) emerged as the largest party with 40.4%, with the Social Democratic Party (SPD) second on 30.4%.

zh.s: 1990年12月2日，柏林举行州选举，选出第12届柏林市议会成员。这是德国和柏林统一后首次在柏林举行选举，同时也与1990年德国联邦选举同日进行。基督教民主联盟以40.4%的得票率成为最大党，社会民主党以30.4%位居第二。

en.s: STS-35 was the tenth flight of Space Shuttle Columbia, in the 38th shuttle mission. It was devoted to astronomical observations with ASTRO-1, a Spacelab observatory consisting of four telescopes. The mission launched from Kennedy Space Center in Florida on December 2, 1990. It was also the first shuttle mission since the Challenger disaster with a crew of seven astronauts.

zh.s: STS-35是“哥伦比亚”号航天飞机的第10次飞行，也是整个航天飞机计划的第38次任务。任务搭载由4台望远镜组成的ASTRO-1太空实验室观测设备，专门用于天文观测。航天飞机于1990年12月2日从佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心发射。这也是“挑战者”号失事后，首次由7名宇航员组成机组的航天飞机任务。

en.s: STS-53 was a NASA Space Shuttle Discovery mission in support of the United States Department of Defense (DoD). It was Discovery's 15th flight. The mission was launched on December 2, 1992, from Kennedy Space Center, Florida. This was also the last mission to have been operated via MCR-2 in JSC. Afterwards the room was restored entirely to its Apollo era appearance.

zh.s: STS-53是美国国家航空航天局“发现”号航天飞机的一次国防部支援任务，也是该航天飞机的第15次飞行。任务于1992年12月2日从佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心发射。这是最后一次使用约翰逊航天中心MCR-2控制室的任务，此后该控制室被完全恢复为阿波罗时代的样貌。

en.s: STS-61 was NASA's first Hubble Space Telescope servicing mission, and the fifth flight of the Space Shuttle Endeavour. The mission launched on December 2, 1993, from Kennedy Space Center (KSC) in Florida. The mission restored the spaceborne observatory's vision (marred by spherical aberration in its mirror) with the installation of a new main camera and a corrective optics package (COSTAR).

zh.s: STS-61是美国国家航空航天局首次维修哈勃太空望远镜的任务，也是“奋进”号航天飞机的第五次飞行。任务于1993年12月2日从佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心发射。宇航员安装了新的主摄像机和校正光学装置COSTAR，修正了太空望远镜主镜球面像差造成的成像问题。

en.s: The Good Friday Agreement or Belfast Agreement (Irish: Comhaontú Aoine an Chéasta or Comhaontú Bhéal Feirste; Ulster Scots: Guid Friday Greeance or Bilfawst Greeance) is a pair of agreements signed on 10 April (Good Friday) 1998 that ended most of the violence of the Troubles, an ethnic and national conflict in Northern Ireland since the late 1960s. It was a major development in the Northern Ireland peace process of the 1990s.

en.s: Ante Up was a professional wrestling supercard event produced by Big Japan Pro Wrestling (BJW). The event took place on December 2, 2001, at the Yokohama Arena in Yokohama, Kanagawa, Japan. The event was themed around BJW's interpromotional rivalry with American promotion Combat Zone Wrestling (CZW). In the main event match, Daisuke Sekimoto and Men's Teioh defeated Kintaro Kanemura and Ryuji Yamakawa to retain their BJW Tag Team Championship and win Kanemura and Yamakawa's WEW Hardcore Tag Team Championship.

zh.s: 《Ante Up》是由大日本职业摔角制作的一场职业摔角特别赛事，于2001年12月2日在日本神奈川县横滨市的横滨竞技场举行。赛事围绕大日本职业摔角与美国推广组织Combat Zone Wrestling之间的推广组织对抗展开。主赛中，关本大介和MEN'S帝王击败金村基康和山川龙司，卫冕大日本职业摔角双打冠军，并赢得对手持有的WEW硬核双打冠军。

en.s: General elections were held in Mozambique on 1 and 2 December 2004 to elect a president and the Assembly of the Republic. en.s: Juicio Final (2005) (Spanish for "Final Justice") was a professional wrestling major show event produced by Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL) that took place on December 2, 2005 in Arena México, Mexico City, Mexico. en.t: K-1 World Grand Prix 2006 in Tokyo Final
en.s: K-1 World Grand Prix 2006 in Tokyo Final was a kickboxing promoted by the K-1 organization. It was the fourteenth K-1 World Grand Prix final, the culmination of a year full of regional elimination tournaments, involving twelve of the world's best K-1 fighters (four being reservists). It followed K-1's classic tournament format - eight fighters compete in a quarter final contests with the four winners advancing to a pair of semi final bouts, and the two winners there clashing in the final. All fights were conducted under K-1 Rules (100 kg/156-220 lbs), three rounds of three minutes each, with a possible tiebreaker.

zh.s: 2006年K-1世界大奖赛东京总决赛是由K-1组织举办的踢拳赛事，也是第14届K-1世界大奖赛总决赛，汇集了全年各地区预选赛的晋级者，共有12名顶尖踢拳选手参赛，其中4人为替补。比赛沿用K-1经典赛制：8名选手先进行四分之一决赛，4名胜者晋级两场半决赛，随后两名胜者争夺冠军。所有比赛均按K-1规则进行，体重级别标为100公斤（156–220磅），每场打3个回合，每回合3分钟，必要时加赛。

en.s: W.A.K.O. World Championships 2007 in Coimbra were the joint 16th edition of the W.A.K.O. world championships and was the second event (the Belgrade event having been held a month previously). The championships were for amateur male and female kickboxers and martial artists, covering the following categories; Full-Contact, Semi-Contact, Musical Forms and Aero Kickboxing. In the contact kickboxing categories (Semi and Full), weight classes ranged from light bantamweight (51 kg/112 lbs) to super heavyweight (over 91 kg/200.6 lbs). The Musical Forms and Aero Kickboxing categories did not have weight classes but had different forms. More information on the categories, weight classes and rules is provided in the various sections below. In total there were around 600 competitors at the event, representing fifty countries from five continents, competing in forty-three competitions. The Coimbra championships were held at the Pavilhão Multiusos de Coimbra in Coimbra, Portugal from Monday, November 26 to Sunday, December 2, 2007.

zh.s: 2007年W.A.K.O.科英布拉世界锦标赛是第16届W.A.K.O.世界锦标赛的联合赛事之一，也是当年的第二场赛事；一个月前已在贝尔格莱德举行另一场。比赛面向业余男女自由搏击选手和武术运动员，设全接触式、半接触式、套路和空中搏击等项目。半接触式和全接触式比赛按体重分级，从轻蝇量级（51公斤／112磅）到超重量级（91公斤／200.6磅以上）；套路和空中搏击不按体重分级，而按不同形式比赛。约600名选手代表五大洲50个国家参赛，共参加43项比赛。锦标赛于2007年11月26日至12月2日在葡萄牙科英布拉的多功能体育馆举行。

en.s: The 2008 United States Senate election in Georgia took place on November 4, 2008. The runoff election took place on December 2, 2008. en.t: Removal of cannabis and cannabis resin from Schedule IV of the Single Convention on narcotic drugs, 1961
en.s: The removal of cannabis and cannabis resin from Schedule IV of the Single Convention on narcotic drugs is a change in international law that took place from 2019 to 2021, on the basis of a scientific assessment by the World Health Organization. Since the United Nations adoption of the Single Convention on Narcotic Drugs in 1961, cannabis and cannabis resin had been listed in Schedule IV, the most tightly restricted category, reserved for drugs that are "particularly liable to abuse and to produce ill effects" and whose "liability is not offset by substantial therapeutic advantages". Its initial placement in this category was not based on science, and no international scientific assessment had been undertaken until 2018. Following the 2 December 2020, vote by the United Nations Commission on Narcotic Drugs, the removal of cannabis and cannabis resin from that Schedule entered into force in 2021.
